The iPhone 18 has just been unveiled—and everyone is talking about what’s new.

But while the world focuses on its latest features, there’s another fascinating question: How is the iPhone 18 actually made?

Behind the sleek glass and metal is an extraordinary manufacturing process involving microscopic chips, precision assembly, advanced robotics, and relentless quality testing.

And the journey doesn’t stop there. We’ll also explore how the Mac mini M6, USB-C cables, and AirPods come to life.

The iPhone 18 is finally here. Now let’s step inside and discover how Apple’s latest technology is really made.
